# Gertie Pye & Josie Pye

- [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) — Sibling of — [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) — since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Autumn P3](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0003)</sub>
- _previously:_ [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) — Relative of — [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) (until v2)  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P90](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0090)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after being late to school. Humiliated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to quit school entirely. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

A Tempest in the School Teapot P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

> The A.V.I.S. throws a farewell party for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they leave for college, though Anne's evening is somewhat ruined by Gilbert's sentimentality and Charlie Sloane's dull company. The next day, after dealing with discouraging goodbyes from local women, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a peaceful evening walk in the woods with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), restoring her spirits.
>
